headline: Six Fronts Surge as Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the map remains largely quiet, but a half‑dozen sectors have sharpened dramatically. Weathered Expanse still dominates the ledger: 24‑hour ownership flips rose to 57, Colonial dead climbed to 8,044 and Warden dead to 12,695 with 425 fresh enlistees. Callahans Passage added six more captures, pushing its daily total to 31 flips; casualties now stand at 9,889 Colonial and 12,091 Warden, with 816 new troops. Fishermans Row has become the newest hotspot, its flips holding at 27 centred on Oceanwatch, Hangman's Court and nearby posts; losses are 384 Colonial and 524 Warden, enlistments 165. Stlican Shelf activity eased to 18 flips, casualties slipping to 2,707 Colonial and 2,880 Warden, enlistments 327. Mooring County steadied at 13 flips, casualties falling to 6,284 Colonial and 7,580 Warden, enlistments 645. Stema Landing, previously quiet, now shows nine flips with modest losses of 19 Colonial and 6 Warden and 51 recruits. All other regions report no ownership changes, indicating the fighting remains concentrated on these six fronts.
